On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the New Westminster total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Condo buildings in Moody Park
The Diplomat — 707 Eighth Street

Built 1977, 22 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records restrictions as: pets not allowed, rentals allowed. Directory amenities: air conditioning, garden, private yard. Current listings describe underground parking and a location across from Moody Park / Massey Theatre area amenities; one listing feature sheet states "Rentals are allowed 100% and sorry no pets." Tower/low-rise form and construction: listings show a low-rise form; construction not confirmed from the sources checked.
Moody Gardens — 777 Eighth Street

Strata plan NWS2534. Current listings describe large 2-level homes, in-suite laundry, parking and storage, with Moody Park directly across the street; one current listing states "2 small pets allowed" — that is listing-level pet information, and a verified building bylaw summary is not confirmed.
The Doncaster — 620 Eighth Avenue

Built 1977, 54 units (building directory, secondary source). The directory records restrictions as: pets allowed with restrictions, rentals allowed with restrictions. Directory amenities: elevator, sauna/steam room, shared laundry, storage, wheelchair access. Current listings place it steps from Moody Park and Mercer Stadium.
Villa Franciscan — 708 Eighth Avenue

On the Eighth Avenue edge at the area's west margin. Built 1976 (building directory, secondary source). A current listing for the building records an elevator, underground parking, and strata-fee inclusions of trash, grounds maintenance, management and snow removal.
Fraser Gardens — 1169 Eighth Avenue
Strata plan NWS1561.

items.t: Moody Park is a City of New Westminster neighbourhood centred on Moody Park itself, in the Uptown-west area between 6th Avenue and 8th Avenue, bounded in the City's heritage context material by 8th Avenue, 8th Street, 10th Street and 6th Avenue. Uptown is to the east, Brow of the Hill to the west, Glenbrooke North to the north, and Downtown and the Quay down the hill to the south.

The apartment stock sits on the edges: Eighth Street and Eighth Avenue around the park (The Diplomat, Moody Gardens, The Doncaster, Villa Franciscan) and Eighth Avenue east toward 12th Street (Fraser Gardens). There are no towers in the sub-area; the verified stock is low-rise.

Landmarks and services on the edges: Moody Park itself (outdoor pool, spray park, sports fields), Moody Park Arena at 701 Eighth Avenue, the New Westminster Public Library Main Branch at 716 Sixth Avenue, and the təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre at 65 East Sixth Avenue, fully opened May 2024.

Transit: no SkyTrain station is inside Moody Park; the nearest are New Westminster Station and Columbia Station (Expo Line) downtown. TransLink routes 105 (Uptown / New Westminster Station) and 106 (Edmonds Station / New Westminster Station) serve the adjoining Uptown corridors.

blocks.text: Good to know about Moody Park

items.t: The condo stock hides on the park's edges, not in the middle. The residential streets between 6th and 10th are RS-zoned houses (RS-1: 557.40 m² minimum site, FSR 0.5); every verified apartment building sits on Eighth Street, Eighth Avenue or the avenues' edges under the multiple-unit RM districts. A "Moody Park condo" search that returns interior-street product is returning something else.
Two of the five buildings are the same age as each other and share a manager pattern worth checking.

The city's newest recreation asset is at the area's east edge. The təməsew̓txʷ Aquatic and Community Centre at 65 East Sixth Avenue fully opened in May 2024 — at 10,644 sq. m. the City's largest capital project to date, with an eight-lane 50-metre pool, leisure pool, fitness centre and gymnasia — a short walk from the Eighth Avenue buildings.

The replacement secondary school is already over capacity. New Westminster Secondary (820 Sixth Street, opened January 11, 2021, $106.5 million, 1,900 seats) is SD40's only secondary school and its long-range facilities plan notes it is already operating above capacity — for family buyers the elementary catchment (Lord Tweedsmuir, with Early French Immersion on site) is the real differentiator between Moody Park addresses.

Moody Park is a documented heritage neighbourhood. The City lists Moody Park among its Historic Neighbourhood Context Statements — heritage status is checked property by property, and work on a listed property can need heritage approvals, which matters for strata exterior-work planning in the older low-rises.

No floodplain zone covers the plateau. The City's floodplain study zones only the low-lying edges (Queensborough, the Quay, the Brunette River and west-end industrial lands) — Moody Park's plateau carries no confirmed floodplain zone, a genuine contrast with the Quay buildings down the hill, though lot-level status is still a City check.

blocks.text: Townhome complexes in Moody Park
Streets, schools and getting around Moody Park

items.t: Where the attached stock actually sits: there is no townhouse node. The strata stock is apartment buildings on the 6th Street / 8th Avenue edges; the streets around the park are single-detached houses under the RS districts.

Transit and roads: no SkyTrain station is inside Moody Park; the nearest are New Westminster Station and Columbia Station (Expo Line) downtown. TransLink routes 105 (Uptown / New Westminster Station) and 106 (Edmonds Station / New Westminster Station) serve the adjoining Uptown corridors; 8th Avenue, 6th Avenue, 8th Street and 10th Street serve the area.

Schools: SD40 catchments are address-based. For the sample address 1714 Eighth Avenue, the SD40 School Locator returns École Lord Tweedsmuir Elementary (K–6, with Early French Immersion at the school itself), Fraser River Middle (6–8) and New Westminster Secondary (9–12); other addresses may differ, and no home is promised a specific school.

blocks.text: Good to know about Moody Park

items.t: The "townhouse" zoning exists even though the townhouse stock does not: Bylaw 6680's Townhouse District RT-2 (s. 410) expressly permits row houses and townhouses, and the OCP carries a whole Development Permit Area (1.3) for townhouse form — a buyer waiting for new townhouse product here is waiting on rezoning and assembly, not on a missing rule.

Heritage is a live check, not a footnote: Moody Park is one of the neighbourhoods documented in the City's Historic Neighbourhood Context Statements, and heritage status must be checked property by property before planning renovations to an older home.

The replacement New Westminster Secondary School, 820 Sixth Street, opened to students on January 11, 2021 — a $106.5 million, 1,900-seat building — and SD40 operates only this one secondary school, which is why the elementary catchment (Lord Tweedsmuir, with Early French Immersion on site) is the real school differentiator on these streets.
The Main Branch of New Westminster Public Library is at 716 6th Avenue, at the area's east edge in Uptown — walking-distance civic infrastructure the townhouse nodes in newer suburbs do not have.

faq.q: What about pets at The Doncaster or Moody Gardens?

faq.a: Yes — strata rental-restriction bylaws have been unenforceable since November 24, 2022 anywhere in BC. The Diplomat's directory line already records rentals allowed; The Doncaster's "rentals allowed w/restrictions" line is older wording. Short-term rentals are a separate question and can still be restricted.
faq.q: Can I rent out a Moody Park condo long-term?

faq.a: The dated buildings are 1976 (Villa Franciscan), 1977 (The Diplomat, The Doncaster), 1983 (Fraser Gardens) and 1987 (Moody Gardens) — 40-to-50-year-old low-rises. Stratas with 5+ lots must now hold a depreciation report renewed every five years and contribute at least 10% of the operating fund to the CRF annually; read both documents before subject removal.
